segments.name: Productivity and Business Processes
segments.note: Office 365, LinkedIn and Dynamics — the workplace software and business apps; revenue up 14% YoY.

segments.name: Intelligent Cloud
segments.note: Azure and server products — the cloud infrastructure business; revenue up 32% YoY.

segments.name: More Personal Computing
segments.note: Windows, Xbox and search advertising — the consumer devices and gaming business; revenue down 4% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Engineers and researchers building products, including AI and cloud.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal, HR and offices.

oneTimers: $3.2B gain from Microsoft's investment in Anthropic, lifting other income and net income.
Lower-than-expected expenses from the Voluntary Retirement Program, partly offset by severance expense and impairment charges in Xbox — together the discrete items added $0.27 to diluted EPS.
$480M net gain from investments in OpenAI (+$0.07 EPS), excluded from non-GAAP results (non-GAAP net income was $35.3B, EPS $4.74).
verdict: Microsoft closed fiscal 2026 with $90B in revenue, Azure up 43% and past $100B for the year — and a $3.2B Anthropic gain flattered the bottom line.
otherDetail: Other income of $3,444M, including a $3.2B gain on the Anthropic investment and a $480M net gain on OpenAI investments.
footerNote: Segments use Microsoft's pre-FY27 reporting structure (Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, More Personal Computing).
follow100Note: Intelligent Cloud is now the largest piece at $43.67 of every $100 — ahead of Productivity and Business Processes at $42.05.

takeaways.title: Azure is still accelerating
takeaways.text: Azure grew 43%, up from 40% the prior quarter, and passed $100B in revenue for the full fiscal year.

takeaways.title: The backlog is enormous
takeaways.text: Commercial remaining performance obligation hit $678B, up 84% — years of contracted cloud and AI spending not yet recognized.

takeaways.title: The bottom line got a boost
takeaways.text: A $3.2B gain on Microsoft's Anthropic investment lifted other income — and discrete items together added $0.27 to EPS.
